proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ H _ _ _ Φ
  let T := InnerProductSpace.toDual 𝕜 H
  let ψ : StrongDual 𝕜 H := ((starL 𝕜 : 𝕜 ≃L⋆[𝕜] 𝕜) : 𝕜 →L⋆[𝕜] 𝕜).comp (Φ.comp (T.toContinuousLinearEquiv : H →L⋆[𝕜] StrongDual 𝕜 H))
  refine ⟨T.symm ψ, ?_⟩
  ext f
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := T.surjective f
  have h1 : inner 𝕜 (T.symm ψ) y = star (Φ (T y)) := by
    rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply]; rfl
  have h2 : T y (T.symm ψ) = Φ (T y) := by
    rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply, ← inner_conj_symm, h1]
    simp
  exact h2
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 H] [CompleteSpace H], Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual 𝕜 H)
